---

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)

raw <- read_json("data/wildfires.geojson", simplifyVector = FALSE)
print(length(raw$features))

first_fire <- raw$features[[1]]
print(names(first_fire))

first_boundary_coordinate <- first_fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
print(first_boundary_coordinate)

wildfires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties)

fires <- wildfires |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |>
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(incident, "August"))

print(nrow(august_fires))

fires |>
  dplyr::slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  dplyr::filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    lon = purrr::map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) mean(purrr::map_dbl(rings[[1]], \(point) point[[1]]))
    ),
    lat = purrr::map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) mean(purrr::map_dbl(rings[[1]], \(point) point[[2]]))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
top_fires <- big_fires |>
  dplyr::slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    popup = paste0(
      "Fire: ", incident,
      "<br>Year: ", fire_year,
      "<br>Acres: ", format(gis_acres, big.mark = ",")
    ),
    geometry = sf::st_sfc(
      purrr::map(geometry_coordinates, \(rings) {
        sf::st_polygon(
          purrr::map(rings, \(ring) {
            matrix(unlist(ring), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
          })
        )
      }),
      crs = 4326
    )
  ) |>
  sf::st_as_sf(sf_column_name = "geometry")

fire_bounds <- sf::st_bbox(top_fires)

leaflet::leaflet(data = top_fires) |>
  leaflet::addTiles() |>
  leaflet::fitBounds(
    lng1 = fire_bounds[["xmin"]],
    lat1 = fire_bounds[["ymin"]],
    lng2 = fire_bounds[["xmax"]],
    lat2 = fire_bounds[["ymax"]]
  ) |>
  leaflet::addPolygons(
    popup = ~popup,
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.5
  )
```
